title: Festacol Nigerian Junior Secondary / BECE Prototype Question Bank

assessmentAlignment.primary: Current Nigerian Junior Secondary School curriculum domains
assessmentAlignment.examStyle: Original JSS3 / NECO BECE-style prototype questions
assessmentAlignment.note: Questions are original prototype items aligned to Nigerian JSS 3 curriculum domains and the subject/difficulty style of the Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE). They are not copied from past papers. Non-single-answer response types are included only to exercise Festacol CBT interactions and do not claim to reproduce NECO paper formats exactly.
